result:
Wrote `final-contract.md` (106 lines) and `resolution-notes.md`.

**Fixed (19 findings):** struck the fabricated constraint cluster (counted values, approximation markers, singleton cardinality, dual ordering) plus its `must never` clause and its leaked example vocabulary; struck the read-only-context constraint; struck the fabricated two-path ambiguity note. Added the required plain-language description on every entry, the documented-vs-built drift sweep, mirroring into the document/path companion registries (explicitly noting ingestion doesn't depend on them), in-label nesting under an existing entry, the weak-name threshold and its flagged forms, and the duty to diagnose which stage dropped a missing entry. Corrected the prefix mechanism (stripped, not supplied), demoted phase/number-leading names from "invalid" to "weak but admitted" while keeping section words a hard rejection, moved extend-don't-duplicate into hard constraints, dropped the invented "avoid churn in shared configuration", replaced "fallback or catch-all" with the real failure (wrong-but-real grouping), and reworded the `moduleLeavesMissingTestDefinitions` transliteration.

**Rejected (4):** 4.2 — the capitalisation clause is a real, independently actionable owner rule (rule 6, "don't rely on all-caps"), not a leaked mechanism; kept and reworded. 5.1, 5.6, 4.1 — the auditor itself concedes these are unavoidable, template-level, or not defects.

**Partial (3):** the six-way ranking (removed the asserted precedence and the invented sixth quality; kept a ranked section since the format requires one, and kept the source-backed verification ordering), the `canonicalDocs` link (part of the record shape rather than a separately mandated step, so phrased as a pointer back to the source record), and the tooling-vs-product filing rule (genuine requirement, reworded to drop the recognisable mirrored phrasing).
